issue.close_reason: Implemented verified read-only checkpoint archaeology: historical query, semantic diff, series search, non-importable outputs, and conformance coverage.
issue.description:
One verified read-only loader materializes a named checkpoint artifact (pointer, manifest, or monolith) into an ephemeral view serving: query against a historical generation without import; a semantic issue/event-level diff between two generations; and predicate-driven search across a generation series. Views are never accepted as import input; outputs are explicitly non-importable.

Acceptance:
- query --checkpoint PATH answers list/query against a committed generation read-only
- sync diff A B reports issue/event-level semantic delta between two generations
- archaeology outputs rejected by every import path
- loader reuses existing verification (hashes, counts, ordering) before serving any view

Refs: plan section 12 R029; ideas-ledger 2026-08-15 finalist 8 dossier (archaeology).
issue.title: R029: Checkpoint archaeology (query/diff/bisect over committed generations)

issue.description:
ADR-005 ships the advisory doctor ready_frontier check for open-but-assigned issues and names a drawback: workspaces that legitimately park work under an assignee will warn on every run, teaching operators to ignore the warning. Work: add a first-class, audited way to mark an assignment as deliberately reserved (recorded on the issue and round-tripped through the checkpoint) that doctor's ready_frontier check treats as intentional, without changing claim eligibility or the default warning; keep ADR-005's advisory posture — doctor never clears assignees, even under --repair.

Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Let an operator mark an assignment as intentionally held so the ready-frontier warning stays meaningful

issue.description:
ADR-005 is Accepted but no open bead implements the diagnostic. Add a `ready_frontier` check to `doctor` under the `dependencies` scope that warns when open issues hold an assignee (excluded from the ready frontier without being an active claim), names a bounded sample of the offending ids, and states the exact remedy (`bead update <id> --clear-assignee`). Advisory only: doctor never clears an assignee, not even under `--repair`. Tests: open+assigned warns; in_progress and closed do not; assigned-but-open with unfinished blockers still warns; a `--repair` run leaves assignment state untouched. Field motivation: 583 stuck issues across 47 workspaces with ten fully starved frontiers, all invisible to doctor.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add doctor ready_frontier check for open issues that carry an assignee (ADR-005)
